items.label: Lightwave Logic Q2 FY2026 (08-11-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Commercial agreements: one material supply and licensing agr

set.signal: Commercial agreements: one material supply and licensing agreement is already in place, and Lightwave is actively negotiating a new agreement with another customer, whose program is the most advanced toward productization, with the goal of beginning volume production in the second half of 2027. CEO: agreement value will depend on material pricing, one-time or recurring licensing fees and royalties, and ultimately on customers' success with end users, typically hyperscalers and AI networking companies; no dollar value per agreement was given.

items.reason: The agreement under negotiation is with a second customer, not the one holding the existing supply/licensing agreement; the patch dropped 'another'.
items.evidence: One such material supply and licensing agreement is already in place, and we are actively negotiating a new agreement with another customer whose program is the most advanced on the path to productization

items.label: Diodes Q2 FY2026 (08-05-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Capacity plan (CEO Gary Yu): Diodes expects 'very strong dem

set.signal: Capacity plan (CEO Gary Yu): Diodes expects 'very strong demand this year, and even more so next year' and says the company has more capacity it can bring online to support customers' future needs, through its hybrid internal / external model. Wafer fabs: utilization keeps improving at GFAB and SPFAB (key customers are starting to use wafers from SPFAB), with migration from 6-inch to 8-inch for more capacity and added capacity from external partners in Korea and Taiwan. About 75% of assembly and test is done internally, with capacity added selectively for advanced packages such as CSP. Production is 'about 50-50' internal versus outsourced. Q2 capital expenditures were $33.6 million or 7.5% of revenue, within the targeted 5% to 9% of revenue range.

items.reason: CEO did not say growth is not limited by capacity; he said growth is not only limited by demand and Diodes has more capacity it can bring online.
items.evidence: So our growth is not only limited by demand; we do have more capacity we can bring online to support the customers' future needs.
